connections.label: Newsletter (Kit)
connections.help: Signups from the site and the Connect window go to this Kit form.

connections.label: Teaching schedule
connections.detail: Collected every night from the studios' booking pages.
connections.help: Classes appear on the site without being typed in.

fields.name: headerImage
fields.label: Header photo
fields.help: The photo behind the site's title along the top. Blank: each season's own photo.

fields.name: uiStyle
fields.label: UI style
fields.help: The overall look and feel, independent of the season: the seasonal colours carry into every style. To try styles and seasons without saving, open the site with ?preview at the end of its address.

fields.name: textSize
fields.label: Text size (%)
fields.help: Scales all the site's text together. 100 is the original size.

fields.name: navCtaLabel
fields.label: Menu button text
fields.help: Shown in the menu bar on the Editorial, Sanctuary and Immersive styles. Blank hides it.

fields.name: actionButtons
fields.label: Buttons under the menu bar
fields.help: The row of buttons just below the menu bar, on every page. A Connect button is added at the end.

fields.name: actionButtonsPerRow
fields.label: Buttons per row on a phone
fields.help: How the buttons under the menu bar sit on a narrow screen. Two per row puts four buttons in a 2 by 2 square.

fields.name: connectIntro
fields.label: Connect window message
fields.default: Find me on social media, or get first word of new classes and events.

fields.name: showFacebook
fields.label: Show Facebook in the Connect window

fields.name: facebookUrl
fields.label: Facebook page
fields.help: The icon shows once this is filled in and the switch above is on.

fields.name: showInstagram
fields.label: Show Instagram in the Connect window

fields.name: instagramUrl
fields.label: Instagram profile
fields.help: The icon shows once this is filled in and the switch above is on.

fields.name: socials
fields.label: Other links
fields.help: More buttons in the Connect window, after Facebook, Instagram and email.

fields.name: newsletterFormId
fields.label: Newsletter form ID (Kit)
fields.help: The signup in the Connect window. Blank hides it there.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.help: The banner shows the next event from today on; once its date passes it moves to the next.

fields.name: startTime
fields.label: Start time
fields.help: As it should read, e.g. 6:30 PM.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Menu order
fields.help: Lower comes first in the menu.

fields.name: className
fields.label: Class name
fields.help: Blank: the next class on your teaching schedule fills in name, date, time and studio.

fields.name: classTime
fields.label: Time
fields.help: As it should read, e.g. 6:00 PM.

fields.name: signUpUrl
fields.label: Sign-up link
fields.help: Blank: the studio's schedule page, when the class comes from your teaching schedule.

fields.name: showEvent
fields.label: Show the next upcoming event below
fields.help: Comes from Events. With no event from today on it is hidden on the site; here it stays visible, marked hidden.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Layout
fields.help: How this section looks. Only the fields that layout uses are shown on the page.

options.label: Splash / hero (text over a full-width image)

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.help: Splash layout: the small line above the heading, e.g. MASSAGE + SOUND HEALING.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body text
fields.help: Splash, Image and text, Centered text and Event layouts.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.help: Image and text layout, and the background photo for Splash.

fields.name: taglinePlacement
fields.label: Tagline artwork
fields.help: Splash only. In Beside and Over the artwork carries the words, so the heading, eyebrow and body are not shown; only the buttons.

options.label: Overlapping the photo (lapped side by side)

fields.name: taglineBlend
fields.label: Tagline blend %
fields.help: Overlapping the photo only: how opaque the artwork is where it laps onto the photo. Blank is 90.

fields.name: taglineHeading
fields.label: Tagline heading
fields.help: Blank: “Your Integrative Healer;”, as in the artwork.

fields.name: taglineLine
fields.label: Tagline line
fields.help: Blank: the artwork’s line, ending “Lasting Health”. Longer text wraps.

fields.name: taglineSize
fields.label: Tagline text size
fields.help: Grows or shrinks all the tagline’s lettering together. 100% is the artwork’s.

fields.name: taglineHeadingFont
fields.label: Tagline heading font
fields.help: Blank follows the site’s heading font (Euphoria Script, the artwork’s, unless the look changes it). Pick a role to follow that, or a font to fix it.

fields.name: taglineLineFont
fields.label: Tagline line font
fields.help: Blank follows the site’s subheading font (Farsan, the artwork’s, unless the look changes it). Pick a role to follow that, or a font to fix it.

fields.name: taglineInk
fields.label: Tagline ink
fields.help: Blank: the season’s colour. “You are resilient” takes it too.

fields.name: imageSide
fields.label: Image placement
fields.help: Auto alternates sides down the page. Pick Left or Right to pin it.

fields.name: imageWidth
fields.label: Image width (%)
fields.help: How wide the image is against the text, 20 to 70. Blank is 45. You can also drag the image's edge on the page.

fields.name: width
fields.label: Section width (%)
fields.help: Blank is the page's own width. You can also drag the section's edge on the page.

fields.name: images
fields.label: Images
fields.help: Event layout: one or more images.

fields.name: cards
fields.label: Cards
fields.help: Card grid layout.

fields.name: words
fields.label: Values
fields.help: Footer layout: the values in one line, separated by blossoms.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.help: Ignored when a linked service is set: that service's status is used.

fields.name: service
fields.label: Linked service (optional)
fields.help: The heading of a Service on this page. The button then shows Available or Coming soon from that service's status.

fields.name: imageSide
fields.label: Image placement
fields.help: Auto alternates sides down the page. Pick Left or Right to pin it.

fields.name: imageWidth
fields.label: Image width (%)
fields.help: 20 to 70. Blank is 45. You can also drag the image's edge on the page.

fields.name: width
fields.label: Section width (%)
fields.help: Blank is the page's own width.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.help: Coming soon disables this service's booking buttons and shows a badge.

fields.name: service
fields.label: Add-on service
fields.help: The heading of another Service. Its button shows Available or Coming soon from that service's status.

fields.name: bookUrl
fields.label: Booking link (this session with the add-on)

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.help: Ignored when a linked service is set.

fields.name: source
fields.label: Source
fields.help: Which tool this comes from, for your reference.

options.label: Teaching schedule (nothing to paste; updates itself)
Newsletter signup (Kit, in the site's own look)

fields.name: url
fields.label: Embed URL
fields.help: URL type: a Canva smart-embed link or an OfferingTree schedule or offering address.

fields.name: code
fields.label: Embed code
fields.help: Code type: paste the snippet exactly as the tool gives it; its scripts run.

fields.name: height
fields.label: Height (px)
fields.help: URL type. Blank is 640.

fields.name: width
fields.label: Section width (%)
fields.help: Blank is the page's own width.

fields.name: newsletterFormId
fields.label: Newsletter: Kit form ID
fields.help: The number in app.kit.com/forms/designers/THIS-NUMBER. Not a key; nothing secret.

fields.name: newsletterAskName
fields.label: Newsletter: also ask for a first name

fields.name: newsletterPlaceholder
fields.label: Newsletter: email box placeholder
fields.help: Blank is your@email.com.

fields.name: newsletterNamePlaceholder
fields.label: Newsletter: name box placeholder
fields.help: Blank is First name.

fields.name: newsletterButtonLabel
fields.label: Newsletter: button label
fields.help: Blank is Subscribe.

fields.name: newsletterSuccess
fields.label: Newsletter: thank-you message
fields.help: Blank is: Thank you, check your inbox to confirm.

fields.name: scheduleLimit
fields.label: Schedule: most classes to show
fields.help: Blank shows everything found (about two weeks ahead).

fields.name: scheduleEmptyText
fields.label: Schedule: message when there are no classes

fields.name: scheduleLinkLabel
fields.label: Schedule: studio link wording
fields.help: Blank is: Full schedule at {studio}.
